verified.analysis: The deal is real, contractual and unfired. The $31 cash price is exempt from numerator re-derivation. CZR trades at $29.03 (FMP quote, 2026-11-02), essentially flat against the $29.08 close on announcement day. New frictions since signing: the FTC issued a second request (WSJ, 2026-09-17); Q3 lost $0.61/share against a -$0.12 estimate, so the standalone downside is widening (Caesars Q3 release, 2026-10-27); landlord VICI booked a $458M credit-loss allowance increase largely tied to Caesars, a sign the lease/LBO structure is contested; and shareholder-litigation firms are investigating the price. Downside if the deal breaks is probably well below $25 given the losses and leverage. A 6.8% gross spread over a 7-13 month regulatory runway is an ordinary late-arc arb that the market is already harvesting, so score is capped at 4 / WATCH. Gaps: the WebSearch budget was exhausted, so state gaming-hearing dates and the exact FTC compliance timing are unverified; there was no 10-Q lookup, which the cash price makes unnecessary.
